Maya (SRE): Logged final postmortem for the tenant isolation incident (peering flap + on-prem route leak). Summary: failover timing + malformed customer route-policy allowed traffic leak between VNIs. Link in docs.

probe-bot: Postmortem created: /incidents/1861239999-tenant-isolation-postmortem.md

Omar (Platform): Can we list owners here so I can add tickets?

Maya (SRE): Short action list:
- Peering health probes (control+data checks)  owner: Omar  due: 2026-06-05
- On-prem policy detector test harness  owner: Nina  due: 2026-06-12
- Dedicated onboarding isolation checks (passive default)  owner: Nina  due: 2026-05-31
- Customer follow-up + NOC checklist  owner: Liu  due: 2026-05-29

Omar (Platform): I'll open INF-4902 for the probe and link PR. Plan: run probes from node netns and add TCP handshake plus route sanity.

Nina (Support): For the verification script I'll default to passive checks (ip route, ip neigh, iptables), optional active capture with consent. ETA ~4 days.

Liu (Customer Success): I'll draft the customer notice and a single-page safe-checklist. Sending to legal now.

Maya (SRE): Recurring pattern note: similar peering-route incidents x2 in last year. Proposing a monthly "isolation retro" to aggregate root causes. Owner: Maya. Start 2026-06-02.

All: please add ticket links to the postmortem doc and update status. Follow-up check on 2026-06-10. :white_check_mark:
